abstract: We transfected the human EJ bladder carcinoma oncogene (Ha-rasEJ-1) into multipotential embryonal carcinoma cell line P19. The transgenic P19(ras+) cells expressed high levels of both the mRNA and the p21EJ protein derived from the oncogene. When cultured in the presence of retinoic acid, P19(ras+) cells differentiated and developed into the same spectrum of differentiated cell types as the parental P19 cells (namely, neurons, astrocytes, and fibroblast-like cells). Thus, it seems unlikely that the Ha-ras-1 proto-oncogene product plays a role in initiation of differentiation or in the choice of differentiated cell lineage. Most of the P19(ras+)-derived differentiated cells contained relatively low levels of p21EJ and were nontransformed, whereas certain cells with fibroblast-like morphology continued to express the Ha-rasEJ-1 gene at high levels and were transformed (i.e., immortal and anchorage independent). Fibroblasts derived from P19 cells did not become transformed following transfection of the Ha-rasEJ-1 oncogene, suggesting that transformation of the fibroblast cells only occurred if the oncogene was present and expressed during the early stages of the developmental lineage.
abstract_ja: ヒトEJ膀胱癌由来の癌遺伝子Ha-rasEJ-1を、多能性胚細胞癌株P19に導入した。トランスジェニックP19(ras+)細胞は高レベルの癌遺伝子mRNAとp21EJタンパク質を発現した。レチノイン酸存在下で培養すると、P19(ras+)細胞は親のP19細胞と同じ分化細胞種(神経細胞、星状膠細胞、線維芽細胞様細胞)へ分化した。したがって、Ha-ras原癌遺伝子産物が分化の開始や系統選択に関与する可能性は低いと考えられる。分化した細胞の多くはp21EJの発現が低く、形質転換されていなかった。一方、線維芽細胞様形態の一部の細胞は高レベルの癌遺伝子発現を維持し、形質転換(不死化かつ足場非依存性)していた。P19細胞由来の線維芽細胞は、癌遺伝子の導入後も形質転換しなかった。これは、形質転換が生じるには、系統発生の初期段階で癌遺伝子が存在し発現している必要があることを示唆する。
